## Selected projects

- [Phantom: IaC Drift Reconciliation SaaS](https://github.com/Kunal23002/iac-drift-saas): Finds AWS console changes that drifted from Terraform and CloudFormation, has an LLM on Bedrock write the fix, validates it with cfn-lint and opens a GitHub pull request. Started as the winning prototype at the AWS × Datadog GenAI Hackathon; I then led a 3-person rebuild into a multi-account SaaS.
- [Cache-aware scale-in for vLLM on Kubernetes](https://github.com/colmeabhi/cache-aware-scale-in): A Kubernetes controller that scores each vLLM replica's KV-cache value and sets pod-deletion-cost, so scale-in removes the coldest replica instead of an arbitrary one — fewer warm caches thrown away, lower time to first token.
- [Duplicate-Safe Order Ledger Service](https://github.com/colmeabhi/idempotent-order-cloud-api): An idempotent order API: same-key retries replay the stored response inside one Postgres transaction, so a client that retries never creates a second order.
- [Parallel N-body simulation](https://github.com/colmeabhi/parallelized-nbody-simulation-cuda-cpp): A galaxy simulation with five solvers compared like-for-like: SIMD serial, OpenMP, a Barnes–Hut octree, and naive versus shared-memory-tiled CUDA kernels.
- [AI Sprint Planning Assistant](https://devpost.com/colmeabhi): Turns a planning spreadsheet into Jira work with a RAG pipeline and multi-tool orchestration. Took 1st place of ~50 teams at the Composio × Redis “Agents with Superpowers” hackathon.
